method: Base artwork generated with built-in image_gen on white, then converted to RGBA cutouts in GIMP 3. See postprocessing.
reference: User-supplied Utterleaf brand board, especially the large upper-left Utterling.
default_final_edit: Use case: precise-object-edit. Preserve this exact Utterling mascot unchanged, including pose, tall curled head silhouette, glossy oval eyes, leaf veins, emerald shading, lime face, little body, feet and side leaves. Change ONLY the background: REMOVE the entire gray checkerboard pattern and replace it with uniform pure white #FFFFFF. White background everywhere outside the character, including gaps between body and side leaves. No floor shadow, no halo, no checkerboard. Center the whole character in a square image with 8 percent white margin on all sides, preserving proportions. No text or extra objects. This is a polished brand illustration for white documentation pages.

variants.listening: Use case: identity-preserve brand mascot illustration. Reference is the definitive Utterling character; preserve its exact tall curled leaf head silhouette, branching veins, layered emerald folds and lime illuminated face, glossy black oval eyes, small green body with feet and two pointed side leaves. Same polished dimensional illustration style, colors and full-body proportions. Produce ONE full-body mascot centered on uniform pure white #FFFFFF background with generous margins, no checkerboard, no extra characters, no words, no labels, no watermark. Change only the expression/gesture described next. Listening pose: slight attentive head tilt, bright open oval eyes, little open delighted smile. Three thin green curved listening wave marks just to the right of its head. Body stays planted, side leaves slightly lifted, friendly and alert.
